author: turboderp
message: Replace scale grid search with golden section search
problem: The parent scale search quantizes sampled tiles repeatedly over a coarse grid and then a finer grid: 12 plus 16 evaluations. An unused outlier-ratio search also remains.
reasoning: Replaces the active grid search with golden-section search over [0.1, 1.9], terminating when the interval width is at most 0.01. One interior function value is reused each iteration. The code explicitly assumes a unimodal quantization-error function; this is an assumption, not a demonstrated property of discrete trellis quantization. The searched interval is broader than the old [0.25, 1.075] coarse interval, so this is not merely an equivalent implementation. Deletes the unused outlier routine and old progress constants.
impact: Reduces repeated sampled-tile evaluations under the search assumption and changes possible selected scales. The packed tensor schema stays the same. The proxy_err naming problem identified in entry 000012 is not addressed by this diff. The extracted `phi` token is the golden ratio variable, not evidence of a Phi model addition.
source_notes: No explicit external URL, paper, issue/PR number or HF repository is present in this commit message and diff. No external source was used for this entry. Evidence is the pinned raw diff and its parent context.
confidence: High for the algorithm and explicit assumption. Performance classification is a reviewed correction from the default feature tag. No GPU timing, quality comparison or unimodality proof was performed.
